vv16:1.1: Yuttā ca te parama-alaṅkatā hayā adhomukhā aghasigamā balī javā abhinimmitā pañcarathāsatā ca te anventi taṃ sārathicoditā hayā. || ||
vv16:2.1: Sā tiṭṭhasi rathavare alaṅkatā obhāsayaṃ jalam iva jotipāvako pucchāmi taṃ varatanu anomadassane kasmā nu kāyā anadhivaraṃ upāgamī ti. || ||
vv16:3.1: Kāmaggappattānaṃ yam āhu anuttaraṃ nimmāya nimmāya ramanti devatā tasmā kāyā accharā kāmavaṇṇinī idhāgatā anadhivaraṃ namassituṃ. || ||
vv16:4.1: Kiṃ tvaṃ pure sucaritam ācarīdha ken' acchasi tvaṃ amitayasā sukhedhitā iddhī ca te anadhivarā vihaṅgamā vaṇṇo ca te dasadisā virocati. || ||
vv16:5.1: Devehi tvaṃ parivutā sakkatā c' asi kuto cutā sugatigatāsi devate kassa vā tvaṃ vacanakarānusāsaniṃ ācikkha me tvaṃ yadi buddhasāvikā ti. || ||
vv16:6.1: Nagantare nagaravare sumāpite paricārikā rājavarassa sirīmato nacce gīte paramasusikkhitā ahuṃ Sirimā ti maṃ Rājagahe avediṃsu. || ||
vv16:7.1: Buddho ca me isinisabho vināyako adesayī samudayadukkhaniccataṃ asaṅkhataṃ dukkhanirodhasassataṃ maggañ c' imam akuṭilam añjasaṃ sivaṃ. || ||
vv16:8.1: Sutvān' ahaṃ amatapadam asaṅkhataṃ tathāgatass' anadhivarassa sāsanaṃ {sīlesv' ahaṃ} paramasusaṃvutā ahuṃ dhamme ṭhitā naravarabuddhadesite. || ||
vv16:9.1: Ñatvān' ahaṃ virajapadaṃ asaṅkhataṃ tathāgaten' anadhivarena desitaṃ tatth' ev' ahaṃ samathasamādhim āphusiṃ sā yeva me paramaniyāmatā ahu. || ||
vv16:10.1: Laddhān' ahaṃ amatavaraṃ visesanaṃ ekaṃsikā abhisamaye visesiya asaṃsayā bahujanapūjitā ahaṃ khiḍḍāratiṃ paccanubhom' anappakaṃ. || ||
vv16:11.1: Evaṃ ahaṃ amatadas' amhi devatā tathāgatass' anadhivarassa sāvikā dhammaddasā paṭhamaphale patiṭṭhitā sotāpannā na ca pana m' atthi duggati. || ||
vv16:12.1: Sā vandituṃ anadhivaraṃ upāgamiṃ pāsādike kusalarate ca bhikkhavo namassituṃ samaṇasamāgamaṃ sivaṃ sagāravā sirimato dhammarājino. || ||
vv16:13.1: Disvā muniṃ muditaman' amhi pīṇitā tathāgataṃ naravaradammasārathiṃ taṇhacchidaṃ kusalarataṃ vināyakaṃ vandām' ahaṃ paramahitānukampakan ti. || ||
